meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把画面素材渲染成视频,并在本地或云端跑通预览与发布全流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要把素材或画面批量渲染成视频,并在本地或云端完成预览与发布。
copy.tagline_en: Render frames into finished videos and run preview through publish locally or in the cloud
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to render frames or footage into videos in batches and preview-to-publish locally or in the cloud.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 HyperFrames CLI 给视频项目做初始化、查找现成动效、写合成,跑 lint 与 check 检查,打开预览链接给你确认后再渲染出视频文件。也可用它排查构建或渲染失败。
howto.when: 当你要求用 HyperFrames 做视频(如初始化项目、预览、渲染),或需要排查构建、渲染失败时触发。

say.text: 用 hyperframes init 建一个新项目
say.note: 生成居中的空白项目骨架

say.text: 在 catalog 里搜一下逐行显示标题的动效
say.note: 返回可 add 安装的现成动效

say.text: 跑一下 check,看这个合成有没有问题
say.note: 先 lint,再查运行时错误与对比度

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude uses the HyperFrames CLI to scaffold a project, search the catalog for existing motion, author compositions, run lint and check, open a preview link for your approval, then render the video. It also diagnoses build or render failures.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to make a video with HyperFrames, such as initializing, previewing or rendering a project, or when diagnosing build or render failures.

say_en.text: Scaffold a new project with hyperframes init
Search the catalog for a headline reveal effect
say_en.note: Returns ready-made motion you can add
Lints, then audits runtime errors and contrast
